summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a 6-K announcing the mailing of meeting materials for a special shareholder meeting to approve its acquisition of Orla Mining Ltd. via a plan of arrangement. Each Orla share will be exchanged for 1.00 Equinox Gold share and $0.0001 cash, with combined ownership split 67% existing Equinox / 33% former Orla shareholders. The boards of both companies unanimously recommend a FOR vote. The deal requires a simple majority vote at the July 22, 2026 meeting; proxy deadline is July 20. Post-close, the combined entity will trade as Equinox Gold on TSX and NYSE American. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearances; risk-arb focuses on vote outcome and integration execution.
